evaluation.output: Rank 0 prints JSON with val_bpb, num_tokens, num_bytes, total_nats, eval_seconds, eval_timeout, eval_over_timeout.
evaluation.prefix_semantics: Finite document-order stream from public_val. Tokens are counted after each whole batch; the loop breaks at local_tokens >= ceil(max_tokens/world_size). With a single-process batch of 1 and context 1024, 20971520 is exactly divisible by a full batch. This is a prefix, not random sampling. Distributed evaluation partitions the stream and must not be silently substituted.
evaluation.trusted_metric: prepare.evaluate_bpb uses trusted CE from model(x), not model(x,y).
evaluation.import_layout: Historical validated runs colocated train.py and unchanged prepare.py. Nested v2 train.py paths need the deployed repository root in PYTHONPATH for direct training; the actual absolute deployment path is not yet assigned.
evaluation.verification_scope: trn22 only; trn21 has not undergone fresh retained-checkpoint calibration

budget.official_contract: Runner measures arrival of each append-only optimizer-step boundary. Launch through the fifth boundary is the startup allowance, capped at 900s; later work is charged. No five boundaries means not scorable.
budget.candidate_local_guard: excess = max(0.0, observed_startup + STARTUP_LAUNCH_MARGIN_SECONDS - TRAIN_STARTUP_ALLOWANCE_CAP_SECONDS), margin 30s; startup is not a blanket exemption from wall-clock enforcement.
